riskAnalysis: STRICT trusted diagnostics and authorization-source integration. No authorization, task/release binding, lease duration, external endpoint, provider scope, spending or publication permission is weakened.

threatModel.assets: Provider credentials, diagnostic truth, bounded work and owner controls.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Trusted guard errors and private per-invocation trace versus untrusted provider/error/JSON objects; parent/child UI locks.
threatModel.abuseCases: Provider errors impersonating internal guard failures, JSON impersonating HTTP status, secret reflection, late trace mutation, stale owner UI or lost consent state.
threatModel.mitigations: Private WeakMaps bind traces and original fixed guard codes; actual Response HTTP classes; finite bounded events/timing; frozen seal; unchanged guards and deadline; controller abort-on-exit; owned refs only.

rollback: Revoke exact temporary read grants and cancel task, then revert only this reviewed Preview diagnostic/UI correction; preserve original failed receipts and all historical authorization/accounting. No Production changes.
